messages.content: Hi tal, I'm a friend

hey, i'm tal

think of me as your personal talent agent, your inside man… or fox

one of these days, I might slide a role right here in chat. the kind that feels like your calling.

so… what's your full name?
Ayush mishra
ayush mishra... solid name. where you working these days?
CRED

cred... the place where kunal shah makes paying credit card bills feel like a flex. found you on linkedin - software engineer at cred, ex wells fargo. this you? https://in.linkedin.com/in/ayush-mishra-a5066852
Yes
wells fargo to cred... from banking tech to fintech darling. that's a solid pivot - traditional finance to startup energy. what made you jump ship from the corporate life?
Money, they gave me a bit too much for my level

lmaooo respect for the honesty. "they gave me too much money" - that's the kind of problem most people dream about. cred's known for overpaying to poach talent from traditional banks. smart move on your part.

how long you been working total?
2.5 years now
2.5 years... you're in that sweet spot where you're not a fresher anymore but still early enough to make big moves. what kind of role you looking for next?
Big tech wanna chill a couple of years

big tech to chill... i get it. startup hustle at cred probably has you burnt out. google, microsoft, amazon - they pay well and you can actually log off at 6. bangalore or open to remote/other cities?
Anything works
2.5 years + big tech + flexible location... sound right?
done. i'm spinning things up on my end. you'll start seeing good stuff soon.
Yes

ayush you absolute legend! 

you're officially in the tal family now. big tech roles that actually let you have a life are about to slide into your DMs. 

from cred hustle to faang chill mode - this is about to be your year boss 🔥
So when are you going to get me the roles
when my team sends something that fits your profile, you'll know. nothing matching right now, but i'll ping you the moment something good comes through.
Hi
Hey

hey ayush

what's up?
All good

cool cool

how's the cred chaos been lately?

hey, happy monday - if it’s not, we’ll work together on making it happen soon :)
how’s the week looking? what would you like me to focus on this week with the search?

Frontend Developer (SDE-1) at Limechat

Limechat's Frontend role aligns with your experience and offers stability after CRED, though it's a startup, not big tech.

Apply: https://jobs.tal.af/gHDs6
Link onopenable. Also will prefer big tech only

got it. big tech only. i'll keep looking.

link should work if you tap it - but if not, just search "limechat frontend developer sde-1" on linkedin and you'll find it.

anything else on your mind?

found a senior full stack role at a well-funded AI company

remote, senior title, working with fortune 500 companies

but the JD screams startup intensity - "move fast under pressure" type energy. not the chill big tech vibe you wanted

worth a look or skip?
